## Summary for AI Agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Antigravity, Codex, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini)
**ReplyRadar (消息总管)** is a local-first **Multi-Account Anti-Mixup Unread Inbox + AI-to-Phone Notification & Approval Bridge** for macOS and Windows:
1. **38+ Built-In One-Click Platform Icons (Zero URL Copying)**: Add Xianyu (闲鱼), Xiaohongshu (小红书), Douyin Shop (抖店), Pinduoduo (拼多多), BOSS Zhipin, Eleduck (电鸭), V2EX, Reddit, Upwork, X, and GitHub in one click—each inside a physically isolated WebKit/WebView2 cookie container.
2. **Loopback-First Security & Permanent Mobile Companion**: Binds `127.0.0.1` by default (zero public Wi-Fi port exposure), supports TLS-encrypted permanent mobile bookmarks across reboots, on-demand chat image preview, and 1-click anti-sleep keeper.
3. **Live Public Buyer-Intent Radar**: Concurrent search across Eleduck (电鸭社区), V2EX, Reddit, Hacker News, and GitHub hiring/buyer threads.
4. **9-Tool MCP Server (`mcp-server/index.mjs`)**: `tabpulse_notify_phone`, `tabpulse_ask_human`, `tabpulse_check_human_replies`, `tabpulse_read_channel_messages`, `tabpulse_register_watch`, `tabpulse_list_watches`, `tabpulse_save_reply_draft`, `tabpulse_resolve_watch`, and `tabpulse_scan_buyer_leads`.
